title: An intelligent imaging system capable of interactive training

pse.problem: Excessive CT doses can induce genetic diseases. Reducing radiation dose leads to a decrease in the quality of CT images.
pse.solution_function: The system performs interactive training on federated learning modules using local CT data and paired standardized low-dose detection data-normal dose image data from each imaging center. It reconstructs low-dose CT original acquisition data into normal-dose CT images using the obtained local imaging models and local network parameters.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes a data acquisition module, federated learning module, and image reconstruction module. The federated learning module is further divided into basic networks for global and local training.
pse.solution_implementation: In supervised training, the cloud basic network is input with paired standardized CT low-dose detection data-normal dose image data to obtain the global imaging model and global network parameters. These parameters are then distributed to each image center for local training using their respective local CT data. The aggregated local network parameters from each image center are uploaded to the cloud.
pse.effect: The system provides low-dose CT images of high quality while protecting patient privacy.
